FINANCIAL EDUCATION · ARE YOU FINANCIALLY READY FOR TOMORROW? (education edition)

Why other economies matter at home

Prices at your local shop are shaped by events far away: shipping costs, exchange rates, harvests and trade rules.

Australia and India both trade heavily with the rest of the world, so global changes reach household budgets.

A falling currency can make imports more expensive; a rising one can do the opposite.

Following official sources such as central banks and statistics agencies helps separate facts from headlines.

Are you financially ready for tomorrow?

Learn. Understand. Stay Informed.
